blurb: Fantasy Dance School provides dance classes for ages 18 months through adults, a Gojuryu Karate program for ages 10 and up, and an after-school enrichment program for children ages 5 to 12. Dance classes include various styles and levels from beginner to advanced, with performance opportunities. The karate program is led by a 7th-degree black belt and emphasizes traditional techniques and character development.
extraNote: Tuition continues until official withdrawal with written notice by the 25th of the month · Registration fees are non-refundable · Late arrivals over 15 minutes may not participate in class · Make-up classes available for recreational dance students, subject to availability · No refunds or credits for missed rehearsals or performances · After-school program late pickup fees apply after 6:00 PM
